purpose: Teach: 社説/説教/白書/争点/若年/文学部/一帯/操業

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療、本気で、絶対、社説、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、注目しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, I want you to know how much the medical team and I genuinely appreciate your careful attention to our work here.
lines.style: Warm but professional. Steady voice with quiet conviction. She's delivering something she means—not ceremonial. Slight pause before his name, as if gathering herself to be direct.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 患者さんへの、本気で、絶対、説教、絶対、にならないよう、絶対、貴院、絶対、配慮されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I've noticed you're careful not to talk down to our patients, sensei. That speaks to the values your hospital must prioritize.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not flattery. Leaning in slightly. A moment of hesitation mid-thought, as if he's working out whether it's okay to notice these things aloud.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。厚労省、本気で、絶対、白書、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、参照しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We reference the Ministry of Health's guidelines closely. The medical team takes that seriously.
lines.style: Clear and direct. She's answering his unspoken question. Slight nod of the head. No elaboration—she trusts he understands why this matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療費の、本気で、絶対、争点、絶対、貴院、絶対、議論、絶対、されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Healthcare costs are something we discuss openly here. It's not a comfortable topic, but we can't avoid it.
lines.style: Quieter now. She's acknowledging the weight of the subject. Thoughtful pause before 'openly.' Her shoulders settle slightly—this is hard, but necessary.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、若年、絶対、患者さん、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、注意して診ております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're particularly careful with younger patients. They deserve the same attention to detail we give everyone, sometimes more so.
lines.style: Patient but firm. A slight emphasis on 'deserve.' She's not being sentimental—she's being clinical about care. Clear-eyed about why it matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医学、本気で、絶対、文学部、絶対、出身の、絶対、研究者、絶対、貴院、絶対、招かれたんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We did bring on a researcher with a humanities background. Different perspectives help us ask better questions.
lines.style: A small hint of warmth—almost a smile in the voice. She approves of his noticing this. Measured pace, but there's a spark of genuine investment in the idea.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。地域、本気で、絶対、一帯、絶対、の、絶対、住民、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、診ております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The whole region depends on us being available at night. It's not glamorous, but it's essential.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but grounded. No self-congratulation. She's stating an obligation she's accepted. Steady breath, as if she's said this before and means it each time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 病院の、本気で、絶対、夜間、絶対、操業、絶対、貴院、絶対、維持されているそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That's something we don't compromise on. Even when it costs us.
lines.style: Final statement. Quieter than before, like she's closing a door gently. Conviction underneath—not defensive, just clear. A pause at the end that suggests she's said what needed saying.
